The tramline zone has frequent evening/night bursts of 50-110 'bicycles' an hour while the adjacent paths are near zero, which may be crowds or light-rail works misclassified rather than cyclists.
decisions.evidence: e.g. 14 Jun 2024 1123 19,67,112,53,35,64,97 per hour 17:00-23:59 (day 714 vs ~15 typical); ~100 days with 60-550, nearly all of it 20:00-05:00; also days when 420 collapses and 421 surges (e.g. 5 Apr, 22 Jun 2024).

decisions.diagnosis: From 6 Feb 2025 the feed publishes only some slots (about half), including some zeros, so the automatic zero fill was not applied; the absent slots look like unpublished zeros, and daily totals are consistent with 2024.
decisions.evidence: 1182 mean 53-77/day in Mar-Nov 2025 vs 44-75 in 2024; nonzero slots per day unchanged (~30) while published slots fell from 96 to ~40-55; no complete days since.

summary: A single VivaCity camera (counter 303) at Tramway Ave, Parramatta, with three zones: the RHS path (420, the main flow ~110-130/day), the LHS path (419, ~3/day except a 1-16 Nov 2023 diversion to it) and the tramline (421, with dubious night bursts). The main faults are whole-camera double (and some triple) counts on single Sydney days, which the auto-fix halved only on some directions, winter data loss before 10:00 local (00:00 UTC) in June-July 2024 and 2025, and several multi-day outages; the Nov 2023 zero_outage fixes on 420 removed real zeros from a diversion. From Feb 2025 the feed omits many zero slots, so days look incomplete although the totals appear correct.
